_meta.about: ECX7-T0: opening Journal Entry (voucher_type Opening Entry, is_opening Yes), party lines, mirror fields
_meta.names: synthetic: company "ECX Probe Co" (abbr EPC), parties and employees named "ECX Probe ..." / "Probe ...", bed users replaced by role labels

apiUsers.apiUserWithSystemManager: token-auth API user holding the 901-bot role set (Accounts Manager/User, Purchase Manager/User, Stock Manager/User, Sales Manager/User, Projects Manager/User, System Manager) plus HR Manager/User and, from the Supplier probe on, Purchase Master Manager
apiUsers.apiUserWithoutSystemManager: same roles minus System Manager (and without Purchase Master Manager)

notes: Create: POST /api/resource/Journal Entry {voucher_type:"Opening Entry", is_opening:"Yes", company, posting_date, user_remark:<key>, accounts:[{account, party_type, party, debit_in_account_currency|credit_in_account_currency}]}. Submit: PUT .../<name> {docstatus:1} (or POST with docstatus:1 in the same body: one call, and a rejection leaves NO draft behind). Cancel: PUT {docstatus:2}.
voucher_type "Opening Entry" forces is_opening to Yes (the case sent is_opening No and the doc came back Yes). voucher_type "Journal Entry" with is_opening Yes is also accepted.

Draft save is permissive: unbalanced, P&L counter-line, group counter-line, single line, negative amounts and a posting date outside any fiscal year all SAVE as drafts. They are refused at SUBMIT (417): unbalanced "Total Debit must be equal to Total Credit. The difference is N"; P&L account "type account X not allowed in Opening Entry"; group account "is a Group Account and group accounts cannot be used in transactions"; no covering year FiscalYearError "Date D is not in any active Fiscal Year for <company>". A draft left behind by a failed submit stays in the ERP and is found by a lookup on user_remark.

Refused at SAVE: no party on a Receivable/Payable line (417 ValidationError "Row N: Party Type and Party is required for Receivable / Payable account X"); party type that does not match the account type (417 "Account X and Party Type Supplier have different account types"); unknown party/account (417 LinkValidationError); both debit and credit zero (417); unknown project (417 LinkValidationError).

Accepted counter-lines: Equity (Opening Balance Equity) and Temporary (Temporary Opening). The plan text "opening-equity account type accepted" holds for Equity and Temporary only; P&L and group are refused at submit.
Party types on a Payable account: Supplier and Employee. Employee is also accepted on a Receivable account (200 on submit): PMO must not offer that. Customer on a Payable account is refused.
One entry can hold many party lines (the receivable case has two customers on one Debtors account, plus one equity counter-line).
user_remark is NOT unique: a second entry with the same key saves and submits. The adapter must look up by [company, user_remark] first, across docstatus 0/1 (a cancelled one is docstatus 2).

Mirror: after submit the GL Entry rows carry is_opening "Yes", voucher_type "Journal Entry" (not "Opening Entry"), project null, cost_center set, fiscal_year of the posting date, remarks "Note: <user_remark>". Party lines have party_type and party; the equity line has none. GL Entry is readable (list with fields) for a user without System Manager.
A cancelled entry writes reversal GL rows (both is_cancelled 1) and CANNOT be deleted afterwards (409/417 LinkExistsError: linked with a Payment Ledger Entry).

Party balance: GET /api/method/erpnext.accounts.utils.get_balance_on?account=&date=&party_type=&party=&company= returns a signed number (receivable positive for debit; a payable credit balance is negative).
Customer create works for the API user; Supplier create needs the Purchase Master Manager role (403 PermissionError without it, also for a System Manager user). Employee is created by the HR roles.

observations: Receivable opening: customer A 1000000 + customer B 250000 debit, equity credit 1250000: submitted, get_balance_on(Debtors, customer A) = 1000000.
Payable opening: supplier A 5000000, supplier B 700000, employee 300000 credit, equity debit 6000000: submitted; payable GL rows carry party_type Supplier / Employee.
